# Popupsmart

Popupsmart is a no-code popup builder for collecting website leads; this toolkit exports leads from one connected campaign.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/popupsmart/.

## Actions

- **List Leads** (read-only): Return one page of leads collected by the connected Popupsmart campaign, optionally filtered by date, plus a cursor for the next page.
